title: Modernization phase assessment (machine form)
groundedBy: .github/scripts/shared/verify-step-artifacts.ps1 :: New-ControlPlaneSkeleton (deterministic No-QA writer; authoritative minimum shape)
authoringNote: Two legitimate producers write this file: the deterministic No-QA skeleton (New-ControlPlaneSkeleton, which always writes reportId + title) and the Step 5 agent (enriched). This contract MUST pass on the skeleton, so the required floor is intentionally identity-only. The operational 'phases' array is NOT required or type-checked here because its enriched shape is owned by Step 5 and may legitimately vary; Steps 7 and 8 read the markdown Phase-Assessment report by exact path and treat this JSON defensively. Step 5's prompt mandates these same identity fields so the producer and this contract stay aligned.
